note: Taylor County (FL) publishes no queryable zoning district service. The county's zoning appears only in the qPublic/Schneider map viewer (Enterprise Zoning layer, viewer-only, no download or public REST endpoint found; the viewer returned HTTP 403). The City of Perry's Official Zoning Atlas is a PDF map. The county planning pages link only to PDF maps and land use text. The statewide Florida cadastral parcel layer has no zoning field. Third-party sources (Regrid, Dynamo, Zoneomics) are paid or not official.
